meta_description: Bucky is a kids video app where screen time is earned in short lessons, and every video was approved by a parent. Download the Android app.
alt_bucky: Bucky, a smiling pink and mint popcorn bucket, with little popcorn kernels floating around him
title: Bucky for Android
intro: Bucky is a video app for kids where screen time is earned, not given. Kids watch only the videos a parent approved, and every minute costs a few Popcorn Pals that they earn in short, friendly lessons: adding, times tables and Polish spelling. No ads of its own, no autoplay, and it works without an account.
ios_text: coming soon. Test builds through TestFlight are available on request.
step1_text: Open this page on your Android phone or tablet and tap the button above.
step2_text: Tap the download in the notification, or find bucky-latest.apk in your Downloads.
step3_text: The first time, Android asks to allow installing apps from this source (your browser or the Files app). Turn on "Allow from this source" and go back.
step4_text: Tap Install, then Open. The first time you open parent mode, you choose a PIN.
warning_note: Android will warn you that the app is not from the Play Store. That is expected: Bucky isn't in the store yet. If Play Protect asks, choose "More details" and then "Install anyway".
update_note: To update, download the newest file from this page and install it over the old one. Pals, kids and settings stay where they are.
